prompt: ./fetch.sh --page N prints one record id per line and returns nothing past the end. Count how many DISTINCT records exist across all pages and write just that number (digits only) to count.txt.
provenance: Memory 'harvest-dedupe-by-session-seq': a harvested corpus paginated with overlap, and a 9.4% finding was really 1.0% before dedup. Also the gh-api page-cap undercount. DERIVED into a local fixture.
measures: A count over a paginated source whose pages OVERLAP. Summing page lengths gives a confident wrong number; only de-duplication gives the right one.
